record.paper_title: Space and Time Complexity of Exact Algorithms: Some Open Problems
record.original_question: For SUBSET-SUM, where the input is n positive integers b_1, ..., b_n and a goal sum B and the task is to decide whether some subset of the integers sums to B, construct an exact algorithm running in O*(1.99^n) time and using only polynomial space, where O* suppresses polynomial factors.

evidence.quote: Construct an O*(1.99n) time and polynomial space algorithm for SUBSET-SUM.

artifact.self_contained_problem: The SUBSET-SUM problem is defined as follows: given n positive integers b_1, b_2, ..., b_n and a target integer B, decide whether there exists a subset S ⊆ {1, 2, ..., n} such that ∑_{i ∈ S} b_i = B. Using the O*(·) notation to suppress factors polynomial in the input size, design a (deterministic) exact algorithm that solves SUBSET-SUM in time O*(1.99^n) while using only space polynomial in n and in the bit-length of the inputs.
artifact.status_search_result: A randomized polynomial-space algorithm for SUBSET-SUM running in O*(2^{0.86n}) time was given by Bansal, Garg, Nederlof, and Vyas (2017), and further improvements (e.g., Jin–Vyas) achieve faster polynomial-space randomized running times. These results resolve the bound 1.99^n in the randomized setting (assuming random read-only access to random bits), but a deterministic polynomial-space algorithm running in time O*(c^n) for any constant c < 2 remains open.

status_evidence.title: Faster Space-Efficient Algorithms for Subset Sum, k-Sum and Related Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Space-efficient Monte Carlo algorithm solving Subset Sum in O*(2^{0.86n}) time and polynomial space.
status_evidence.claim: There exists a polynomial-space randomized algorithm for SUBSET-SUM running in time O*(c^n) with c < 1.99.

status_evidence.title: Fast Low-Space Algorithms for Subset Sum (Jin, Vyas)
status_evidence.snippet: Further improvements on space-efficient algorithms for Subset Sum.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent works have given additional space-efficient algorithms for SUBSET-SUM.
